jobs.title: Manager/Asst. Manager Treasury Front Office
jobs.description:
Job Details:
Qualification: Minimum of a Master’s degree in Finance , Business or related discipline from a leading international or local university recognised by the Higher Education Commission (HEC) of Pakistan. ACI Certificate/CFA Level 1/NIBAF Treasury Certificate may be an added advantage.
Experience: Minimum 4(four) years, for Assistant Manager and Minimum 5(five) years for Manager, of relevant work experience in a Treasury of a bank/DFI/NBFI or FMAP accredited brokerage house.
Location: Karachi
Grade: AVP II - VP I
Key Responsibilities:
Money Market & Liquidity Management
 Execute money market transactions in accordance with the Bank’s Treasury & Investment Policy and approved limits.
 Evaluate money market conditions, liquidity trends, yield curve movements, and cash flow forecasts to identify investment and funding opportunities.
 Actively manage daily liquidity positions and explore investment avenues to maximize portfolio yield while maintaining liquidity buffers.
 Maintain active interbank dealing and market execution via dealing platforms.
Market Research, Intelligence & ALCO Support
 Monitor macroeconomic indicators, monetary policy actions, interest rate trajectories, and global/domestic market trends.
 Conduct continuous financial market research to formulate yield forecasts and actionable investment insights for management.
 Prepare comprehensive treasury MIS, daily liquidity reports, portfolio performance analytics, and market commentary for the Asset and Liability Committee (ALCO) and executive leadership.
Settlement Coordination, Compliance & Risk Governance
 Coordinate seamlessly with the Treasury Back Office and Finance teams to ensure accurate execution, deal confirmation, timely settlement, and reconciliation.
 Ensure strict adherence to State Bank of Pakistan (SBP) Prudential Regulations, Cash Reserve Requirements (CRR), Statutory Liquidity Requirements (SLR), and internal limits.
 Maintain strong knowledge of treasury-related accounting treatments (IFRS 9), financial reporting, and operational risk controls.
 Build and nurture professional relationships with financial institutions, interbank counterparties, SBP, brokerages, and custodians.
Systems Development, Policy & Automation
 Contribute to the enhancement, user acceptance testing (UAT), and process automation of the Treasury Management System (TMS) to drive efficiency and reporting accuracy.

jobs.title: Expert Tariff Classification & Policy
jobs.description:
Required Academic Qualifications & Professional Experience: Master’s degree (or equivalent 16/18 years of education) in International Trade, Economics, Public Policy, Customs Administration, International Trade Law, Supply Chain Management, Chemical / Industrial Engineering, or a closely related discipline from an HEC-recognized national or reputable international university.
Specialized international certifications in WCO Harmonized System classification, Rules of Origin, or Tariff Architecture (from WCO, WTO, ITC, or recognized customs academies) will be considered a decisive advantage.
Experience: Minimum of 15 years of progressive, demonstrable professional experience in customs tariff administration, international trade policy, classification jurisprudence, or industrial tariff rationalization.
In-depth practical experience working within or extensively advising customs administrations (e.g., Pakistan Customs / FBR), national tariff authorities, line ministries (Commerce, Industries, Finance), multilateral organizations (WTO, WCO, World Bank, ADB, UNCTAD), or leading industrial advisory groups. Direct, proven experience in formulating, reviewing, or negotiating the Customs Tariff Schedules (Pakistan Customs Tariff / 1st and 5th Schedules) and official Federal Budget Finance Bills.
Technical Skills & Domain expertise
Exemplary WCO HS Expertise: Comprehensive mastery of General Rules of Interpretation (GRIs), Legal Notes, Explanatory Notes, and classification precedents across all 97 HS Chapters.
Industrial Value-Chain understanding: Proven ability to dissect industrial production processes, input-output ratios, and value-addition stages from basic commodities to complex processed / engineered goods.
Concordance & Statistical Systems: Hands-on understanding of concordance crosswalks across HS editions and mapping HS codes to ISIC, BEC, and CPC schemas.
Fiscal & Economic Modeling: Familiarity with effective protection calculations, static revenue estimation, and partial equilibrium trade simulation tools (e.g., WITS-SMART).
Communication & Synthesis: Superior technical writing skills with demonstrated capability to translate dense tariff data into crisp, executive-level decision briefs.

jobs.title: Officer/Junior Officer – Administration
jobs.description:
Job Detail: Officer/Junior Officer – Administration
Qualification: Minimum of a Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Business Administration or DAE in Civil Engineering or other related fields from a leading local or international university recognised by the HEC of Pakistan.
Experience: Minimum 2(two) years of relevant work experience for Officer and 1(one) year for Junior Officer in Administration/General Services preferably in a bank/DFI or public sector organisation(s) or established corporate entity.
Grade: OG-III to OG-I
Job Location: Islamabad
Key Responsibilities: Facilities & Operations Management
 Oversee day-to-day general administrative operations, facilities, equipment maintenance, and outsourced staff functions.
 Plan and manage preventive maintenance for building systems (HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and structural components).
 Conduct regular inspections of the premises to identify wear and tear, maintain cleanliness standards, and ensure high operational efficiency.
 Ensure organisational vigilance by supervising security personnel, monitoring guard movements, and ensuring overall site safety.
 Perform periodic functional checks on CCTV security cameras, fire alarms, fire extinguishers, and overall safety systems.
 Ensure strict adherence to health, safety, and environmental (HSE) standards and fire safety protocols across all premises.
 Coordinate repairs, asset disposals/auctions, and facility improvement or expansion projects.
 Provide on-site administrative support during special events, critical operations, and official functions.
Timely Procurement & Vendor Management
 List down the procurement needs over the period and initiate the process at least 3 months before the requirement.
 Provide detailed need analysis, requirement and specification to the Procurement team.
 Coordinate with contractors, vendors, and service providers for routine maintenance, renovations, and office supplies.
 Manage procurement and timely distribution of stationery, pantry supplies, and consumable inventory.
 Oversee administrative operations concerning outsourced personnel, security management, and travel logistics (boarding and lodging).
 Track and manage lease/service agreement renewals for Head Office and Regional Offices.
Financial Administration & ERP Processing
 Process invoices, vendor payments, TA/DA claims, and medical reimbursements within the ERP system.
 Manage petty cash disbursements and reconcile monthly utilisation reports.
